List of candidate SNPs

import os,gzip,pickle,time,bisect,collections,concurrent.futures
import pysam
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse

def extract(chrom):
 t=time.time()
 with open(f'snp_sites/{chrom}.pkl','rb') as f:sites=pickle.load(f)
 pos=sorted(sites); observations={}; nr=0; used=0
 bam=pysam.AlignmentFile('pooled.sorted.bam','rb')
 for a in bam.fetch(chrom):
  nr+=1
  if a.mapping_quality<20 or a.flag & (4|256|512|2048):continue
  if not a.has_tag('CB') or not a.has_tag('UB'):continue
  st=a.reference_start; en=a.reference_end
  ix=bisect.bisect_left(pos,st)
  if ix==len(pos) or pos[ix]>=en:continue
  cb=a.get_tag('CB'); umi=a.get_tag('UB'); seq=a.query_sequence; quals=a.query_qualities
  rp=st;qp=0
  for op,n in a.cigartuples:
   if op in (0,7,8):
    j=bisect.bisect_left(pos,rp)
    while j<len(pos) and pos[j]<rp+n:
     p=pos[j]; q=qp+p-rp;j+=1
     if q<3 or q>=len(seq)-3 or quals[q]<20:continue
     ref,alt=sites[p]
     b=seq[q]
     if b"'!=ref and b!=alt:continue
     d=observations.setdefault(p,{})
     key=(cb,umi)
     allele=int(b==alt)
     if key not in d:d[key]=allele
     elif d[key]!=allele:d[key]=2
    rp+=n;qp+=n
   elif op in (1,4):qp+=n
   elif op in (2,3):rp+=n
 keys=[];r=[];c=[];ad=[];dp=[]
 barcodes=[line.split()[0] for line in open('"'barcodes.counts.tsv')]; bmap={b:i for i,b in enumerate(barcodes)}
 for p,d in sorted(observations.items()):
  counts=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
  for (cb,u),x in d.items():
   if x<2:counts[cb][x]+=1
  refn=sum(v[0] for v in counts.values());altn=sum(v[1] for v in counts.values())
  if min(refn,altn)<5 or min(refn,altn)<.03*(refn+altn) or len(counts)<15:continue
  row=len(keys);keys.append((chrom,p+1,*sites[p],refn,altn))
  for cb,(rr,aa) in counts.items():
   r.append(row);c.append(bmap[cb]);ad.append(aa);dp.append(aa+rr)
 shape=(len(keys),len(barcodes))
 sparse.save_npz(f'snp_counts/{chrom}.AD.npz',sparse.csr_matrix((ad,(r,c)),shape=shape,dtype=np.float32))
 sparse.save_npz(f'snp_counts/{chrom}.DP.npz',sparse.csr_matrix((dp,(r,c)),shape=shape,dtype=np.float32))
 with open(f'snp_counts/{chrom}.sites.pkl','wb') as f:pickle.dump(keys,f)
 return chrom,nr,len(observations),len(keys),len(dp),round(time.time()-t)

if __name__=='__main__':
 os.makedirs('snp_sites',exist_ok=True);os.makedirs('snp_counts',exist_ok=True)
 chroms=list(map(str,range(1,23)))
 if not os.path.exists('snp_sites/22.pkl'):
  groups={c:{} for c in chroms}
  with gzip.open('common.hg19.vcf.gz','rt') as f:
   for line in f:
    if line.startswith('#'):continue
    a=line.split('\\t',5);ch,p,_,ref,alt=a[:5]
    if ch in groups and len(ref)==len(alt)==1:groups[ch][int(p)-1]=(ref,alt)
  for ch,d in groups.items():
   with open(f'snp_sites/{ch}.pkl','wb') as f:pickle.dump(d,f)
  del groups
  print('sites ready',flush=True)
 with concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as pool:
  for result in pool.map(extract,chroms):print(result,flush=True)
 ads=[];dps=[];sites=[]
 for ch in chroms:
  ads.append(sparse.load_npz(f'snp_counts/{ch}.AD.npz'));dps.append(sparse.load_npz(f'snp_counts/{ch}.DP.npz'))
  with open(f'snp_counts/{ch}.sites.pkl','rb') as f:sites.extend(pickle.load(f))
 sparse.save_npz('AD.npz',sparse.vstack(ads));sparse.save_npz('DP.npz',sparse.vstack(dps))
 with open('sites.tsv','w') as f:
  for s in sites:f.write('\\t'.join(map(str,s))+'\\n')
 print('DONE',len(sites),flush=True)
PY

import os,time,json,concurrent.futures
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from vireoSNP import Vireo

def fit_job(args):
 k,seed=args;t=time.time()
 ad=sparse.load_npz('model.AD.npz').tocsc();dp=sparse.load_npz('model.DP.npz').tocsc()
 np.random.seed(seed)
 init=None
 if seed==0 and k>1:
  z=np.load('svd.npy')[:,:max(k,8)]
  lab=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=15,random_state=42).fit_predict(z)
  init=np.full((dp.shape[1],k),.01);init[np.arange(dp.shape[1]),lab]=.99
 model=Vireo(n_cell=dp.shape[1],n_var=dp.shape[0],n_donor=k,ID_prob_init=init)
 model.fit(ad,dp,max_iter=250,delay_fit_theta=5,verbose=False)
 prob=model.ID_prob;labels=prob.argmax(axis=1)
 result={'k':k,'seed':seed,'elbo':float(model.ELBO_[-1]),'iterations':len(model.ELBO_),'sizes':np.bincount(labels,minlength=k).tolist(),'confident':np.bincount(labels[prob.max(axis=1)>.95],minlength=k).tolist(),'theta':model.beta_mu.tolist(),'seconds':round(time.time()-t)}
 np.savez_compressed(f'models/k{k}.s{seed}.npz',ID=prob,GT=model.GT_prob,theta=model.beta_mu,theta_sum=model.beta_sum,ELBO=model.ELBO_)
 with open(f'models/k{k}.s{seed}.json','w') as f:json.dump(result,f)
 return result

if __name__=='__main__':
 os.makedirs('models',exist_ok=True)
 ad=sparse.load_npz('AD.npz');dp=sparse.load_npz('DP.npz')
 covered=np.asarray((dp>0).sum(axis=1)).ravel();ref=np.asarray((dp-ad).sum(axis=1)).ravel();alt=np.asarray(ad.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
 keep=(covered>=40)&(np.minimum(ref,alt)>=(ref+alt)*.05)
 ad=ad[keep].tocsc();dp=dp[keep].tocsc()
 sparse.save_npz('model.AD.npz',ad);sparse.save_npz('model.DP.npz',dp);np.save('model.keep.npy',keep)
 print('matrix',dp.shape,'nonzero',dp.nnz,'per cell count quantiles',np.quantile(np.asarray(dp.sum(axis=0)).ravel(),[0,.1,.5,.9,1]),flush=True)
 p=np.asarray(ad.sum(axis=1)).ravel()/np.asarray(dp.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
 # Count each covered locus equally for an initial genetic embedding.
 inv=dp.copy();inv.data=1/inv.data
 af=ad.multiply(inv);mask=dp.copy();mask.data[:]=1
 x=(af-mask.multiply(p[:,None])).multiply(1/np.sqrt(p*(1-p))[:,None]).T.tocsr()
 coverage=np.asarray(mask.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
 x=x.multiply((1/np.sqrt(np.maximum(coverage,1)))[:,None]).tocsr()
 svd=TruncatedSVD(n_components=24,random_state=42);z=svd.fit_transform(x)
 np.save('svd.npy',z);print('SVD',svd.singular_values_,flush=True)
 jobs=[(k,s) for s in range(3) for k in range(1,13) if k>1 or s==0]
 with concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
  for r in pool.map(fit_job,jobs):print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)
PY
